thread:
Maya (CS): Quick intake: NimbusCare wants to onboard a proprietary 13B summarizer tuned on clinical notes. They asked for Dedicated or Private, HSM-backed keys, and strict no-logging. Renewal in ~40 days, so they're time-sensitive.
Ibrahim (Solutions): Are they sending artifacts or a registry image? We need to know tokenizer type and context length.
Maya (CS): They supplied a container image with manifest and a short model card in the ticket. Link: internal ticket NC-1177.
Zoe (Eng): Action items for eng: pull image, verify tokenizer (bpe vs sp), check quantization state. If not quantized we'll experiment with int8. Also need sample prompts for tokenization checks.
Ravi (Security): PHI in training data -> require signed DPA, PI/PHI leakage scan, and confirmation that telemetry is disabled. Customer insists keys stay under their control.
Olga (CSM): Renewal note: they mentioned budget constraints but will upgrade to Dedicated if pilot is successful. Mark renewal risk high and I'll coordinate pricing options with Sales.
Ibrahim (Solutions): Proposed pilot acceptance: perf smoke (p95 <1.2s for 256-token calls), 150 domain QA prompts for quality, and a privacy stress run (600 targeted prompts). I'll build the prompt sets.
Zoe (Eng): Fastest path: Dedicated with customer-provided wrapped keys if they accept key-wrapping. Private will need VPC peering and HSM exchange, estimate 10-12 business days.
Ravi (Security): Clarify: if keys cannot leave customer network at all then Dedicated is not viable. Ask NimbusCare if wrapping is acceptable. Security needs HSM contact and key policy to proceed.
Maya (CS): I'll ask them to confirm key handling and to provide a 2-3 sentence token sample and the model manifest.
Olga (CSM): I'll loop Sales in and prepare a short pilot-pricing addendum. Also will surface renewal extension options in NC-1177.
scheduler-bot: Meeting scheduled: "NimbusCare model intake: kickoff"  Tomorrow 9:30am PT. Invite and staging creds sent.
Maya (CS): Added acceptance checklist to NC-1177: tokenizer sample, signed DPA, security signoff, eval pass (perf + quality + privacy), and deploy plan. Follow-ups in the ticket.
